verdict.rationale: cubic's built-in AI can take delegated tasks inside the product. You tag @cubic-dev-ai in PR comments to ask questions, trigger reviews or Ultrareviews, and request fixes. It generates fixes and pushes them to the PR branch via one-click "Fix with cubic" or auto-fix across every review, and an AI chat answers questions about a PR using codebase context. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of task delegation (community evidence covers review quality only); the AI chat sidebar is documented only under an archive path, so its current status is unclear; delegable tasks are confined to review, fix and Q&A rather than open-ended work.
